scope: independently authored runbook-query text; same synthetic corpus; no agent alert or LLM

rows.query: Checkout is failing for a lot of customers, the payments service is throwing 500s and charges are getting rejected by the processor. Where do I start?
The payment handler is raising exceptions and the share of payment requests returning server errors jumped well above normal. How do I triage it and confirm we're back to healthy?
The gateway's p95 has been above 2 seconds for a while even though traffic is light. What should I look at?
Requests through the gateway are slow at the tail but throughput is low; how do I tell whether a slow downstream call or an overloaded worker is the culprit, and when can I call it recovered?
Gateway resident memory keeps climbing in a straight line until the process gets restarted, and then it starts all over again.
Since the last gateway release its RSS never comes back down; I suspect a cache that never evicts or requests being held onto. How do I grab a heap profile safely and should I prepare a rollback?
Gateway CPU is pinned above 90% and the request queue keeps getting longer.
Gateway pods are compute-bound and a backlog is building up; could an expensive code path be eating cycles, and is it OK to switch off optional batch work to relieve it?
Payments is logging connection refused whenever it tries to reach the downstream dependency it relies on. What checks should I run?
The payment service can't get a connection to its dependency, I'm seeing connection pool exhaustion errors and wondering if DNS for that endpoint is broken.
We shipped a new payments version 15 minutes ago and errors started right after; the canary pods look worse than stable. Should we roll it back, and what do I need to do that?
Payment failures kicked off right after today's payments deploy. I want to show the new build regressed by pulling a failing trace and comparing canary to stable before asking the owner to revert.
Last night's backup ended with status failed and an error code, maybe the client was offline. What do I check before rerunning it?
A backup job errored out and I suspect the destination repository was unreachable or the credentials or policy were wrong. How do I diagnose it without losing our last good restore point?
The backup repository is reporting zero free disk and backup writes are failing.
Our backup target is completely full. Can I delete old snapshots to make room, and how should I check retention before I do?
Payment requests to the processor keep exceeding the configured client timeout and the gateway's response times are rising too. How do I check the connect timeout and retry count?
The card processor is now slower than the timeout we give it, so payment calls time out. What evidence do I need before proposing a longer timeout?
Request volume on the gateway has roughly doubled but most of it is retries, and completed checkouts are dropping.
Clients keep retrying a failing dependency and it's amplifying the load; how do I check whether the circuit breaker opened and cap the number of retry attempts?
We got paged about 30 times for what is clearly the same gateway problem. How do I collapse these into one?
The Alertmanager webhook keeps redelivering the same alert and we open a new incident each time; how do I make it idempotent using the alert fingerprint?
An alert fired for one short spike and then cleared on its own, and no users seem affected. Do I need to open an incident?
I think the alert was caused by a gap in Prometheus scraping or a quick burst of traffic. How do I confirm it wasn't real and document why I silenced it?
Several services are alerting at once, but some are hurting users badly and others barely at all. How do I decide what sev level this is?
Failed user requests are spreading across more services and I want to raise the incident's priority level; how do I justify and record that change?
The gateway is slow and payments is erroring at the same time. How do I figure out which one is the actual cause and which is just a symptom?
I want to follow trace IDs from the gateway spans down into the payment spans to find the first span that actually failed. What should my root-cause hypothesis cite?
A payments alert fired around the time of a release, but I'm not convinced the deploy caused it. How do I gather evidence either way?

Before I blame the rollout for this payments issue, what should I record (version, rollout time, change ticket, baseline error rate), and how do I rule out a dependency that just happened to fail at the same time?
The backup finished as partial: some data got written but not all of it. How do I find out what was skipped?
Bytes written by last night's backup are much lower than the last healthy run and a few clients show errors or excluded paths. How do I rerun just those?
Our backups all report success, but nobody has ever actually tried restoring from them. How do I prove they're usable?
How should I restore a backup into a non-production target, check the checksum and that the application can read the data, and time how long recovery takes?
The payment processor started returning 401 unauthorized on every request.
I think the processor API key expired during rotation or we're referencing the wrong secret. How do I investigate without leaking the secret into logs?
New gateway replicas come up but never pass their readiness check.
Gateway pods boot but stay out of rotation because the probe keeps failing after startup; could it be a startup dependency or the wrong probe path?
Someone wants to push a risky config change to payments while a severe incident is still open. What sign-offs and checks do we need before it's executed?
An engineer wants to apply an untested payments config change during a change freeze. Who has to approve it (owner, QA, security) and what test evidence must be attached?
